<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0105-16-13" status="unreviewed">'o na 'dod pa'i khaMs gyi gzugs <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="108a4"/> tshogs bcas yin gyi | ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang
            bsgyur ba'i gzugs bsaM gtan dang po laso pa'i myig gi yul du byungd pa'i 'od kyi rang            bzhin gyi gzugs te thogs med yin na | thogs dang bcas pa gzugs cad bcu' zhes bshad pa
            dang 'gal lo zhe na | 
            
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4261">mchims</rs> na re mi 'gal te thogs pa dang bcas pa de yod na gzugs can
            chul la yod pas de skad brjod pa yin gyi | gzug pa cha bzung po <expan>thams cad</expan> thogs bcas <lb n="108a5"/> yin pa ni min no zhes zer ro || </seg></TEI>
